listing.name: TimeSplitters 2 — split2-recomp (phobos665)
listing.summary: The project reports frontend, story and System Link deathmatch play. Challenge and MapMaker have had little testing. System Link is Windows-only. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PAL or USA Xbox disc extracted default.xbe; other revisions/Japan not accepted.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Generate C from x86 code and build against DirectXbox-Recomp using the project’s instructions. Windows uses VS2022 or VS2019. Apple Silicon macOS and Linux have source-build instructions.

warnings: The project reports frontend, story and System Link deathmatch play. Challenge and MapMaker have had little testing. System Link is Windows-only.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
